Live Above It All — The Pinnacle by STJ Group, Mohali

Standing tall at 36 floors, The Pinnacle offers panoramic views, futuristic engineering, and an elite lifestyle in the heart of Mohali's booming urban landscape.

Rera No - PBRERA-SAS81-PR1166

The Pinnacle Mohali – An Iconic Landmark of Luxury Living

Where Prestige, Architecture, and Lifestyle Come Together in IT City, Mohali

The Pinnacle, developed by STJ Group under the Mohali City Centre (MCC) umbrella, is more than a luxury apartment — it's an architectural masterpiece rising in the heart of IT City, Mohali. Designed by India's legendary architect Hafeez Contractor and styled by celebrity interior designer Zafar Choudhary, The Pinnacle sets a new standard in urban living.

With expansive 3 BHK, 4 BHK apartments, and exclusive penthouses starting from ₹3 Crore, this G+35 icon offers breathtaking views, modern engineering, and unmatched elegance.

Specifications

Premium materials and finishes — every detail engineered for durability, beauty, and comfort.

StructureRCC framed structure with shear walls – earthquake resistant (Zone IV)
External WallsAutoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC) blocks with two-coat plaster
Internal WallsAAC blocks with gypsum finish for smooth surface
WaterproofingCrystalline waterproofing in basement & terrace; IWC in wet areas
FaçadeHigh-performance structural glazing & aluminium composite panels
Doors8-foot solid core flush doors with premium hardware
WindowsUPVC double-glazed windows with mosquito mesh
Living & DiningItalian marble / 800×800 mm vitrified tiles (anti-skid)
Master BedroomEngineered hardwood flooring / premium vitrified tiles
Other Bedrooms600×600 mm vitrified tiles in designer pattern
BalconiesAnti-skid ceramic tiles with weather-resistant finish
KitchenAnti-skid ceramic tiles with dado up to 2 ft
BathroomsNon-slip ceramic tiles floor & wall dado up to full height
Corridors & LobbyPremium marble / granite with designer pattern
Kitchen PlatformGranite / engineered stone counter top with SS sink
CabinetsModular kitchen with laminated shutters (soft close)
Chimney & HobProvision for chimney & hob with gas pipeline
Appliance SpaceBuilt-in provisions for refrigerator, microwave & dishwasher
Water SupplyHot & cold water supply with ISI marked CP fittings
Utility AreaSeparate utility room with washing machine provision
Sanitary WareKohler / Jaquar brand wall-hung EWCs
FittingsSingle-lever hot & cold CP fittings (Kohler / Grohe)
Master BathroomRain shower + hand shower with glass partition
VanityDesigner vanity with under-counter basin & mirror cabinet
AccessoriesTowel rail, soap dish, toilet paper holder (branded)
ExhaustExhaust fan provision in all bathrooms
WiringConcealed copper wiring with FRLS cable (Havells / Polycab)
SwitchesModular switches (Schneider / Legrand)
Power PointsSufficient power points in all rooms including AC, TV & charging
Air ConditioningSplit AC provision in all bedrooms & living room
Home AutomationSmart home automation panel (optional upgrade)
Power Backup100% DG power backup for common areas; partial for apartments
